fullContentHtml:
Railway RRB Technician CEN 02/2026 Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Railway Recruitment Board (Ministry of Railway) has released Admit Card for the recruitment of Technician Grade-I & Grade-III on the official website of the RRBs. This recruitment was released for 6565 posts. Applications for the Railway RRB Technician Recruitment 2026 were accepted from June 30, 2026, to July 29, 2026. The CBT-I examination is going to conducted on 06-09 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Railway RRB Technician CEN 02/2026 Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 30 June 2026
  • Last Date : 29 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 29 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 06-09 October 2026
  • Exam City Details : 27 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 04 Days Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General : Rs. 400/-
  • OBC, EWS, SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Railway RRB Technician CEN 02/2026 Admit Card 2026?

Railway RRB Technician CEN 02/2026 Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
